blurb: Luna Park in Coney Island is a seaside amusement park with family-friendly attractions, thrill rides, shopping, dining, and special events. It features historic landmarks and new rides including roller coasters and thrill rides. The park is adjacent to beaches and the boardwalk, providing a world-class destination for all ages.
